# Laura de Castro

> Senior Product Marketing Manager based in Madrid, Spain, working across Europe. 10+ years turning product ideas into positioning that sticks and go-to-market plans that actually go.

Laura bridges product, sales, and marketing: positioning and messaging, GTM strategy, sales enablement, and market/competitor research. AI is built into her workflow — lead generation systems, competitive intelligence, and prompt-driven research tools.

## Core expertise

- Customer and Market Research — turning research into strategies teams can act on
- Brand, Positioning & Messaging — building brand identity and stories from zero
- GTM Alignment — bridging Product, Sales, and Marketing for faster launches
- Data to Decision — turning data into decisions, not week-long debates

## Industries

Cloud & Cybersecurity, Fintech & Web3, Marketplaces, AI & Emerging Tech

## Career achievements

- Built and scaled an AI-powered B2B lead generation system, growing leads by 30% at Aire; cut campaign execution time by 50% at Billionhands
- Designed a referral program that brought in 200,000 traders in year one and scaled a 10,000+ member token community at 2gether
- Led the WalletConnect GTM integration at Qredo: 50% lead growth, +30% wallet activations, +2 point NPS

## Personal projects

- [Purpose & Prompt](https://lauradecastro.substack.com/): Substack newsletter on AI applied to product marketing
